modelCorrection.en: Rhizoids are root-like threads that hold a bryophyte to a surface. Bryophytes have no true roots.

text.en: Spirogyra takes in water and nutrients straight through its surface.
A plant with xylem and phloem must also make seeds.

modelCorrection.en: A fern has xylem and phloem and makes no seeds.

text.en: Xylem and phloem let a fern live away from standing water, but it still needs moist conditions to reproduce.
